title: Concrete World Demon
description: A surreal scene on a cracked concrete platform features a wooden mannequin-like figure inside a glass snow globe, its chest blooming with a pink rose while holding a smaller globe. A large demonic red eye with thorny lashes floats above, connected by red tendrils and lightning, with the word DEMON visible on a ribbon. Pink roses, grapes, and blue orbs spill onto the stone surface beneath a stormy purple sky.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene on a cracked concrete slab under a stormy purple sky with lightning. A wooden articulated mannequin stands inside a large glass snow globe on a wooden base, its chest open with a glowing pink rose, holding a smaller blue orb. A massive demonic red eye with green thorny eyelashes floats above, connected by red ribbons with the word DEMON. Pink roses, grapes and blue orbs spill from the globe onto the concrete. Dramatic lighting, ominous atmosphere.
